$comment: Controls a native rule answers in frameworks it does not map itself, kept apart from the rule classes because they were derived rather than written: each entry was carried over from the Prowler checks that asked the same question as the rule, and pairs known to ask slightly different questions passed nothing on. A framework a rule maps in its own compliance_mappings never takes an entry from here (DECISIONS.md section 168). Edit by hand. CIS_CONTROLS_8.1, CSA_CCM_4.1, NIST_800_171_R2 and DORA are the exception to the Prowler provenance: they were written by hand, rule by rule, from what each rule's evidence shows (DECISIONS.md sections 205 and 206).
